info.title: Bet Better Free Sports Betting Model API
info.description: Free, no-key JSON feeds of Bet Better's model output: win probabilities, fair odds and a dated verdict for every published selection. The feed carries the model's own numbers only — no bookmaker names and no market prices. Licensed CC BY 4.0: free to use with attribution to Bet Better (https://betbetter.world). Model estimates for research. Not betting advice. 18+. Gamble responsibly. Each league's free picks are live for everyone. Every other pick is for members: its row carries locked: true and unlocksAtUtc (the kickoff, when it leaves the free feed), keeps game, gameTimeUtc and market, and has empty-string selection, confidence and verdict and null numbers.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv or json. Same rows and field names in both.

200.description: One row per upcoming game the model has priced

league.name: league
league.description: League path segment. Soccer and tennis use two segments (e.g. soccer/epl, tennis/atp) — substitute the whole segment.

format.name: format
format.description: Must be 'json' — without it the endpoint returns the human HTML page.

sport.name: sport
sport.description: Sport key for the predicted-scores feed. Soccer is one key covering every published league.

page.description: Canonical human page for this feed

licence.description: CC BY 4.0 — free to use with attribution to Bet Better (https://betbetter.world)

lockedCount.description: How many picks in this response are locked (members only)

error.description: Present only when the feed could not be built; picks is then empty.

game.description: Fixture, e.g. 'Melbourne Demons vs Fremantle Dockers'

selection.description: The model's selection Empty string while the pick is locked.

winProbabilityPct.description: Our prediction: the chance we give this selection, percent. This is the same number we publish, track and grade.

probabilityLabel.description: Plain-words name for winProbabilityPct, e.g. 'our prediction'

modelProbabilityPct.description: DEPRECATED - identical to winProbabilityPct, kept so existing clients do not break. The raw model-only number is not published on this free tier; it is a licensed odds-feed field labelled 'model-only (raw), for odds feeds'.

fairOdds.description: Decimal odds implied by our prediction: always 100 / winProbabilityPct, rounded to 2 decimals. Our number, never a bookmaker price.

confidence.description: Empty string while the pick is locked.

verdict.description: Dated plain-English verdict Empty string while the pick is locked.

locked.description: true on a members' pick (game, start time and market only)

unlocksAtUtc.description: On a locked pick: the kickoff, when it leaves the free feed. null on free picks.

lockedPicks.description: On a locked row only: how many members' picks the row stands for. Locked picks on the same game and market (and player, on prop feeds) look the same, so they share one row.

home_margin.description: Projected home score minus away score

home_win_prob.description: Model's chance the home team wins: the next three games of each sport; null for the rest (every game in the paid Predictions feed)

margin_source.description: How home_margin was produced, e.g. derived_from_win_prob
